card.name: Linking words before gene or science terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, the, an or new right before a technical biology or science term, plus odd spots like a quote mark after a Star Trek episode tag.

modes.label: Linking word before gene terms
modes.description: A short word like for, the or an just before a gene, protein or allele name.
modes.example: is wsp, which codes<< for>> cell membrane proteins.

modes.label: Quote after episode tag
modes.description: An opening quote mark after a series abbreviation such as TOS: before an episode title.

modes.label: Start of a split name
modes.description: The first piece of a long proper name that continues in the next piece.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a gene or science term, and on a few unrelated odd spots.
